stem: Kid pulls hot coffee off the table & onto himself. Distressed mother calls you with child crying in the background. Best management?

options.text: Instruct to go to hospital (call ambulance) & call DOCS
Instruct to go to hospital & call ahead to the hospital
Put in shower as is & soak
Remove clothes, cold water fro 20 minutes & keep warm
